This is a WORKED EXAMPLE for grayton-blue-mountain; copy its shape for other districts (filename must equal the district route slug + .json). Schema: {slug, name, floodingNotes:[{text, source}], basins:[], lakes:[], phase1Examples:[], localAsk:{hearingRef, emailTemplate}, sources:[]}. HONESTY RULES: every floodingNotes[].source should be a real citation; where a claim is illustrative or not yet confirmed, keep '[UNVERIFIED]'/'[ILLUSTRATIVE]' inline in the text. basins/lakes associations are '[UNVERIFIED]' pending an authoritative hydrologic map. phase1Examples are candidate/illustrative projects, NOT adopted. localAsk.emailTemplate is a suggested resident message — it must contain NO per-property dollar figures and use 'special assessment', never 'tax'. TO EDIT: GitHub → PR → Vercel Preview → merge.
name: Grayton Beach / Blue Mountain Beach

floodingNotes.text: The Grayton Beach street grid sits low and close to Western Lake, a coastal dune lake, so heavy rain can pond on streets and carry untreated runoff toward the lake. [ILLUSTRATIVE summary — confirm specifics against county drainage studies before citing as fact.]

Coastal dune lakes like Western Lake are rare and water-quality-sensitive; reducing untreated stormwater reaching them is a core goal of the plan. [UNVERIFIED for this district's specific loadings — general characterization.]

localAsk.hearingRef: Bring this to a Walton County BCC regular meeting (2nd & 4th Tuesday, 4:00 PM Central). Confirm the agenda at mywaltonfl.gov/162/Meetings-Agendas.
localAsk.emailTemplate:
Subject: Support dedicated stormwater funding for Grayton Beach / Blue Mountain

Dear Commissioners,

As a resident/property owner near Grayton Beach and Western Lake, I support creating a dedicated stormwater program funded by a special assessment so we can reduce street flooding and protect our coastal dune lakes. Please advance the plan's public-notice and hearing steps and keep the community informed.

Thank you,
[Your name]
[Your street / neighborhood]
